verdict.rationale: AutoGen's AgentChat docs list a first-party Memory feature to "Add memory capabilities to your agents," so the product does ship its own memory capability. The evidence is only a one-line index entry, though, and never shows that memory persists across sessions or threads. Missing for 10: documented persistence across sessions and threads, details on memory backends or stores, cross-thread sharing semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can give agents long-term memory that persists across sessions and threads
